title: Full Stack Developer
description: Architect and deploy end-to-end production web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js), TypeScript, Next.js, Docker, and Cloud CI/CD pipelines.

nodes.title: Internet & Web Architecture
nodes.description: Understand HTTP/HTTPS protocols, DNS resolution, client-server architecture, web browsers, and REST principles.

nodes.title: HTML5 & Semantic Web
nodes.description: Master semantic markup, forms, inputs, DOM tree structure, web accessibility (a11y), and SEO fundamentals.

nodes.title: CSS3 & Responsive Layouts
nodes.description: Master CSS Box Model, Flexbox layout, CSS Grid, media queries, CSS variables, and mobile-first responsive design.

nodes.title: Git & GitHub Version Control
nodes.description: Master Git workflows, branching, commits, pull requests, merge conflict resolution, and GitHub team collaboration.

nodes.title: Modern JavaScript (ES6+)
nodes.description: Master JavaScript fundamentals, DOM manipulation, Async/Await, Promises, Closures, ES Modules, and Fetch API.

nodes.title: Tailwind CSS & UI Styling
nodes.description: Build modern responsive web interfaces using Tailwind CSS utility classes, custom themes, and component styling.

nodes.title: React.js Component Architecture
nodes.description: Build interactive single-page applications using JSX, React Hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo), and Custom Hooks.

nodes.title: React Router & SPA Routing
nodes.description: Implement client-side Single Page Application routing, dynamic URL parameters, nested routes, and protected routes.

nodes.title: Node.js Core Runtime
nodes.description: Understand asynchronous JavaScript runtime, Event Loop, native modules (fs, http, path), NPM ecosystem, and environment variables.

nodes.title: Express.js REST API Server
nodes.description: Architect scalable backend RESTful APIs, custom middleware, request/response handlers, routing, and error handling.

nodes.title: MongoDB & Mongoose ODM
nodes.description: Design NoSQL document databases, collections, CRUD operations, Mongoose schemas, data validation, indexing, and populate relations.

nodes.title: JWT Authentication & API Security
nodes.description: Implement Secure JWT authentication, password hashing (bcrypt), HTTP-only cookies, CORS, Rate Limiting, and Helmet headers.

nodes.title: Global State Management (Redux / Zustand)
nodes.description: Manage global application state, asynchronous data fetching, and caching using Redux Toolkit or Zustand.

nodes.title: Full Stack TypeScript
nodes.description: Apply static typing, interfaces, generics, and strict type checking across frontend React components and backend Express routes.

nodes.title: Next.js & Server Components
nodes.description: Build full-stack production web apps with Next.js App Router, Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), and Server Actions.

nodes.title: Relational Databases & SQL (PostgreSQL)
nodes.description: Master SQL query writing, relational database models, PostgreSQL, and ORM integration (Prisma / TypeORM).

nodes.title: Docker & Containerization
nodes.description: Containerize Node/Express backend microservices and React frontend apps using multi-stage Dockerfiles and docker-compose.

nodes.title: Full Stack Testing (Vitest & Supertest)
nodes.description: Write component unit tests with Vitest / React Testing Library and REST API integration tests with Supertest.

nodes.title: Production Deployment & CI/CD
nodes.description: Automate GitHub Actions CI/CD deployment pipelines, deploy frontends to Vercel and backend microservices to Render/AWS.

nodes.title: Production MERN Capstone Project
nodes.description: Build and deploy a full-featured MERN application (E-commerce / SaaS) with Auth, Stripe Payments, Real-time WebSockets, and Cloud DB.

nodes.title: Full Stack Portfolio & System Design
nodes.description: Package live deployed applications, GitHub codebases, API documentation, and system design architecture diagrams.
